FINDER F4b, PART 3e: TWO REMAINING PRODUCT-JOURNEY FAILURES, ON THIS BRANCH. The reviewer ran the journey locally again on 09de1fae plus main, with the same cypress-parity.yml setup. Part 3d's waits fixed the URL checks: the new journey now gets well past them. Two failures remain.

FAILURE 1, the new journey, after the clean-session load of the copied page-3 URL: `cy.wait('@selectedPoint')` (GET /api/v1/systems/9007199254740993) times out because no request is made. The cause in ExploreWorkspace.svelte: needsSelectionResolution is false whenever retainedSelectedSystem holds a valid point, and the $effect that sets retainedSelectedSystem takes it from selectedInCatalogue when the catalogue viewport contains the selected system. V3 Lossless Reach (18.25, -7.5, 42.75) is inside the initial catalogue viewport near Sol, so the catalogue answers first and getSystem is never called. Whether the request happens therefore depends on which response arrives first. The F4 design (section 5, "Inspect, map and later weight pop-out") says: when the selected id64 is absent from the current result page, resolve it through the facade's getSystem call. Section 7 step 5 makes the journey wait for that request. Follow the design: with the flag on, the retained selected point for a URL selection that is not on the current page comes from the result page, the retained point from an earlier result page in the same session, or getSystem. Never from the catalogue viewport, so a clean-session load always makes that one request. Keep the flag-off path exactly as part 3c left it (main's behaviour, catalogue included). Add a Vitest case where the catalogue answers first with the selected system and getSystem must still be called once.

FAILURE 2, the existing journey "discovers, selects, spatially picks...": at its first results check after visiting /explore, `[data-system-result]` is not found within the default 4,000 ms, although the summary already says "Showing 3 of 3". On this slow browser the flag-on page takes longer to render the list after its first canonical-URL pass. Use part 3d's settle helper (or the explicit 15,000 ms timeout pattern) before that check, and before any other first-render result checks in that journey that use the default timeout. Do not change what they assert.

SCOPE: apps/web (ExploreWorkspace.svelte, its tests and product-journey.cy.ts). No API, workflow or docs changes.

CHECKS TO RUN in apps/web with Node 24 and pnpm 11.25.0: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm format:check, pnpm test, pnpm build, plus the workload test from part 3c, which must still show flag-off parity with main. Python: python -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py.

FINAL ANSWER: the code path you changed for failure 1, every changed file with one line each, the workload counts after the change, and the check results.
